question: By whose agency does the speaker come to know the determination of the Kaula doctrine?
premises: The speaker addresses the Lord of the Kaulas.
By the Lord's grace the speaker has come to know.
What is known is the determination of the Kaula doctrine.
inference: The determination of the Kaula doctrine is known to the speaker by the grace of the Lord of the Kaulas.
uncertainties: The prior state of ignorance is implied but not detailed.
plain_english: By your grace, O Lord of the Kaulas, I have come to know the determination of the Kaula doctrine.
